Class ObservationRecorder

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.coverage.journey.ObservationRecorder
public final class ObservationRecorder extends Object
Records execution observations keyed by stable CoverageTarget identity.

Retry and duplicate-view mutations collapse onto the same identity and do not inflate coverage (SC-2). Coverage is derived only from recorded evidence (FR-2).
